## studio

**Studio: assets, generation and publishing.** Main Studio entry point for visual creation on your own account: character/scene/prop assets, the output and reference library, generation jobs, and actual image and video rendering. Pick an operation with `action`. Video always goes through storyboard first (`storyboard_plan` -> `draw_storyboard` -> user approval -> `storyboard_video`); `generate_video` is disabled. Async results differ by action: `generate_image` / `storyboard_video` return `outputs[]` with signed download links or a `pending` result to poll via `studio_outputs`; `process_asset` / `edit_asset` are polled with `get_asset`; narration and montage actions finish synchronously. It also covers motion-graphic drafts, motion template library, Director productions, audio/video plan, folders, social posting and SEO blog actions.

## studio_project

**Director project.** Editor (per-shot) projects: list, open, create from a brief or template, change settings, move from review to rendering, and manage saved versions. Use it to start or inspect a project before editing shots with `studio_shots`, layers with `studio_layers`, audio with `studio_audio` and export with `studio_export`. A single spend over 50 HWT first returns `needs_confirmation` with a `confirm_token`; repeat the identical call with the token after the user agrees.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list` | `read` |  | List your editor projects |
| `get` | `read` |  | Full project: settings, shots, stills, overlays, av_plan, final output |
| `create` | `edit` |  | New project without a source video. body: {origin: template\|brief\|production, template_id\|brief\|production_id, ratio?, workflow?, shot_count?, language?} |
| `analyze` | `spend` | paid | Paid: reverse a reference video into an editable project. body: `{source, title?, mode?, chunk_sec?, language?}`. |
| `composite` | `edit` |  | Compose mode: build a new free project from already-rendered shots of other projects. body: `{title?, pieces:[{rid, n, in?, out?}], audio?, unify?, strength?, join?}`. |
| `settings` | `edit` |  | Change workflow, resolution, ratio, gen_mode, vo_language, title, refs… |
| `replan` | `edit` |  | Re-cut a reference-video project's shot grid without re-analysing (review only; shot text is inherited by time overlap). body: {mode: fixed\|merge\|trim, chunk_sec, workflow} |
| `reblueprint` | `edit` |  | Re-extract per-shot subject / location / on-screen text when the analysis left them empty (free, does not re-watch the video) |
| `notes` | `edit` |  | Turn the analysed transcript and shots into study notes (free, no re-analysis). body: {focus?, language?} |
| `start` | `edit` |  | review → rendering (shots can be generated after this) |
| `reopen` | `edit` |  | done/error → review |
| `variant` | `edit` |  | Clone as another language version. body: {language} |
| `translate` | `edit` |  | Translate voice-over and on-screen text. body: {language\|languages} |
| `checkpoint` | `edit` |  | Save a restorable version. body: {note} |
| `versions` | `read` |  | List saved versions |
| `restore` | `edit` |  | Restore a saved version |
| `version_fields` | `read` |  | Per-shot text fields of a saved version (compare an old version with the current shots; read-only) |
| `delete_version` | `edit` |  | Delete one saved version |
| `lint` | `read` |  | Prompt lint (read-only) |
| `log` | `read` |  | Generation log |
| `delete` | `edit` |  | Delete the project |
| `estimate` | `read` |  | Exact HWT price to render the project's shots. args: {only?: [n…]} |
| `strip` | `read` | image | View the film strip of the whole source video (returns an image). |

## studio_shots

**Director shots.** Shot list of an editor project: edit shot fields, reorder, choose which shots to generate, approve or redo, set frames and still cards. `render`, `render_all` and `render_frame` spend HWT and return job ids at once; call `collect` afterwards to adopt finished clips. A single spend over 50 HWT first returns `needs_confirmation` with a `confirm_token`.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patch` | `edit` |  | Edit shot fields. body: {shots:[{n, ff_desc?, motion_desc?, vo_text?, on_screen_text?, refs?, …}]} |
| `reorder` | `edit` |  | Reorder shots. body: `{order:[n…]}`. |
| `add` | `edit` |  | Append an LLM-written shot to a scene. body: {brief, refs?, after?} |
| `select` | `edit` |  | Choose which shots to generate; the rest keep the source clip. body: {generate:[n…]} |
| `frame_from_output` | `edit` |  | Use a library image as a frame. body: {output_id, role: first\|end\|mid} |
| `accept` | `edit` |  | Approve a shot |
| `redo` | `edit` |  | Send a shot back for another take |
| `keep` | `edit` |  | Keep the source clip for this shot. body: {keep: bool} |
| `import` | `edit` |  | Copy a shot from another project. body: {from_rid, from_n, with_frame?, with_clip?, with_dur?} |
| `reframe` | `edit` |  | Change aspect ratio. body: {ratio, mode: crop\|pad} |
| `vo_suggest` | `edit` |  | Write a voice-over line for the shot |
| `libclip` | `edit` |  | Put a library video into this shot. args `{mode: use\|ref\|'', ref:{asset_id\|output_id, in?}}`: `use` plays it from `in` (free), `ref` feeds the model's video slot, `''` clears. |
| `libclip_isolate` | `edit` |  | Keep a library clip's picture and sound separately. body: {video: bool, audio: bool} (video off + audio on = generate the shot and lip-sync to the clip's sound) |
| `clear_voice` | `edit` |  | Remove the user's own recorded voice from a shot |
| `add_still` | `edit` |  | Cover/ending/poster card. body: {output_id, kind, after_n, dur, label?} |
| `patch_still` | `edit` |  | Edit a still card |
| `remove_still` | `edit` |  | Remove a still card |
| `render` | `spend` | paid | Paid: submit one shot for rendering and return at once with its `job_id`; then call `collect`. |
| `render_all` | `spend` | paid | Paid: submit every pending shot that is not already generating; returns job ids at once, then call `collect`. args `{only?}`. |

Flow: references, then storyboard board, then pick model/style, then `cut` to render. References are given as `{pillar,id}`, `{asset_id}` or `{output_id}`. Call `guide` first for the steps and all options; `storyboard_draw` and `cut` spend HWT and a storyboard version approved by the user is required before `cut`.

| `cut` | `spend` | paid | Paid: render the video (Cinematic/Highlight Cut); returns `job_id`. `storyboard` (user-approved version id) is required; `clip_in`/`clip_out` (≤30 s segment) are billed by length. |

## studio_clipper

**Clip highlights from long video.** Long-video highlight clipper: a long video is transcribed word by word, AI picks highlights, and short 9:16 vertical clips are rendered. The default motion-edit style is the note-explainer layout (hook, persistent topic title, word-by-word captions, paper-collage illustrations, Instagram copy); `layout: motion` keeps the original motion look. Use `quote` for prices, `analyze` to find candidates, then `render` or `render_range` to cut clips.

| `list` | `read` |  | List recent analyses. |
| `get` | `read` |  | Get an analysis's status, candidate clips (`id`, `t0`, `t1`, `title`, score) and rendered clips. |

## studio_talk_reel

**Talk reel: captions, motion graphics, sound.** Speaker Reel (motion-graphics director template): turns a video of a person talking into a fully automatic polished 9:16 reel. It does word-level transcription with dead-air cutting (pauses, fillers, stutters; spoken words are never cut), subject cut-out framing, word-by-word captions with keyword emphasis, motion text timed to the speech, and voice cleanup with sound effects and loudness. Duration must be 3-180 seconds with speech. One flat fee covers the first render plus 3 re-renders via director notes.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `guide` | `read` |  | Explain the flow, styles, options, director-note chips and how cut-out is handled. |
| `styles` | `read` |  | List all styles (id, background, three colors, type feel, sound effects). |
| `quote` | `read` |  | Quote: args `{source:{asset_id\|output_id}}`; returns `fee_hwt` (flat fee including 3 re-renders) and duration. |
| `start` | `spend` | paid | Paid: open an order, charging the flat fee. args `{source:{asset_id\|output_id}, style?, mode?: auto\|step, captions?, sfx?, backdrop?, matte?, music?, title?, language?, …}`; returns a job id. |
| `list` | `read` |  | List recent speaker reels (id, status, style, duration, output). |
| `get` | `read` |  | Get one order: status, progress, transcript with pause/stumble list, scene plan, report, versions, `revisions_left`, and a suggested next step. |
| `words` | `edit` |  | Transcript review gate (`review_words`): args `{fix:[{i, w}], keep_pauses:[k], keep_stumbles:[k]}` to correct words (`i` = word index) and keep the listed pauses/stumbles; the rest are cut. |
| `plan` | `edit` |  | Plan review gate (`review_plan`): args `{keys:[{s, i}], scenes:[{id, drop?, kind?, layer?, fields?, word_i?}]}` to change a sentence's keyword and edit scenes. |
| `next` | `edit` |  | Pass a gate: `review_words` leads to the plan, `review_plan` leads to rendering (already covered by the flat fee). |
| `notes` | `edit` |  | Director note: produce a new version (3 included in the flat fee). args `{text?, chip?, range?:[start_sec, end_sec], scene?, frames?, colors?}`; `chip` is one of the note chips from `guide`. |
| `cancel` | `edit` |  | Cancel: before the first version it cancels with a full refund; after a version exists nothing changes and outputs are kept. |

## studio_confirm

**Confirm a spend.** Approval cards for spending and permissions. When an action returns `needs_confirmation` + `confirm_token` (or `needs_permission` + `permission_token`), call `show` to display the card, then call `wait` (up to 50 seconds per call; call again while `open`). On `approved` repeat the original call with identical args plus the token; on `declined` do not proceed. With `approval: "user"` (only when the key's owner turned on page approval) only the user can approve, on the `approve_url` page on AlgoHash while signed in; a yes in chat does not count and `decide` cannot approve. Hosts without cards should give the user the `approve_url`.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `show` | `read` |  | Show a quote approval card (`confirm_token`) or permission card (`permission_token`); does not charge or consume the token. args `{confirm_token\|permission_token, summary?, what?}`. |
| `decide` ⁽¹⁾ | `read` |  | Record the user's decision; called by the card when the user taps, the agent should not call it itself. For `approval: "user"` tokens it can only decline; approving returns `user_required` and the user must approve on `approve_url`. args `{confirm_token\|permission_token, decision:'approve'\|'decline'}`. |
| `wait` | `read` |  | Call right after `show` (or after giving the user the `approve_url`) to wait for the user's decision (up to 50 s; `open` means undecided, call again). args `{confirm_token\|permission_token, timeout_sec?}`. |

⁽¹⁾ No SDK wrapper on purpose: this action is pressed by the approval card UI, not by your code. See [approvals](../approvals.md).

## studio_collage

**Collage Flow: voiceover to paper-collage film.** Collage long-take (Director mode / Create card): a narration becomes one visual metaphor per sentence, built as a stop-motion of halftone black-and-white photo cut-outs and color swatches on flat colored paper. `flow` mode is one continuous take with a carry-over object crossing every sentence boundary; `solo` rebuilds each sentence from empty paper. Gates: pick concept, approve metaphors per sentence, approve stills (paid), render first/last-frame animations (paid), then free stitching and QA. The final film has no audio track. `auto {brief, budget_hwt}` runs everything as an AI director, then loop `auto_step`. Call `guide` first.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `guide` | `read` |  | One-page flow guide: gates, modes, models and durations, which action to use at each step, and how to handle errors. |
| `options` | `read` |  | Available animation models (duration range, tier, whether usable now), aspect ratios, modes and still resolutions. |
| `auto` | `edit` |  | AI director: create a board from `brief` with required `budget_hwt` cap (plus `seconds`, `mode`, `aspect`, …); returns `board_id`, then loop `auto_step`. With `board_id` pauses/resumes or sets budget. |
| `auto_step` | `spend` | paid | Paid: run the AI director's next step within budget; returns `do`: `wait`, `done` (`film_output_id`, `qa_verdict`), `stop` (`why`) or `paused`, with `spent_hwt`, `left_hwt` and progress. |
| `plan` | `edit` |  | Create a board. args `{text (narration, max 12 sentences), mode?: flow\|solo, aspect?, title?, language?, brief?, video_wf?, video_res?, still_res?, hold_sec?, style?, …}`. |
| `replan` | `edit` |  | Regenerate the three concepts (clears per-sentence work). args may change `{text, brief, mode, aspect, language, title}`. |
| `list` | `read` |  | List the user's collage boards (id, status, sentence count, approved count, stills/animations count, final `output_id`). |
| `get` | `read` |  | Get everything about a board: `status`, `concepts[]`, `pick`, `beats[]` (line, meaning, thesis, objects, carry, bg, sec, approved, still, video), `film`, `qa`, plus the suggested next step. |
| `pick` | `edit` |  | Pick a concept. args `{concept: 0\|1\|2}`; the per-sentence metaphors are then written in the background (10-40 s; existing sentences are rewritten in bulk). |
| `revise` | `edit` |  | Rewrite one sentence's metaphor from a note. args `{n, note}`; it must be re-approved afterwards. |
| `edit` | `edit` |  | Edit directly without AI (free). args `{params?:{aspect, mode, video_wf, …}, beats?:[{n, meaning?, objects?, bg?, sec?, trans?, approved?, …}]}`; the response lists stale stills/animations. |
| `approve` | `edit` |  | Approve in bulk. args `{what: beats\|stills, ns?:[sentence numbers] (default all), ok?: false (withdraw)}`; stills can only be approved where an image exists (others return `skipped`). |
| `quote` | `read` |  | Quote without charging. args `{what: stills\|videos, ns?}`; returns `fee_hwt` per sentence, `total_hwt`, and why some sentences cannot be produced (`skipped`). |
| `render_stills` | `spend` | paid | Paid: render one still per sentence. args `{ns?, refs?:[…] (max 3), seed?}`; returns job ids, then `collect`. |
| `render_videos` | `spend` | paid | Paid: render first/last-frame animations (one per sentence: empty paper to still in `solo` and for sentence 1, previous still to this still in `flow`). args `{ns?}`; returns job ids, then `collect`. |
| `collect` | `edit` |  | Collect results: checks submitted stills/animations, attaches finished ones to their sentence (`collected[]`) and records failure reasons (money is refunded automatically). |
| `adopt` | `edit` |  | Use an existing library output as a sentence's still or animation. args `{n, what: still\|video, output_id}`. |
| `view` | `read` | image | View a comparison image (returns an image): one row per sentence with animation first/middle/last frame and the still; use it for the user to approve stills or to check joins. |
| `film` | `edit` |  | Stitch the film for free. args `{hold_sec?}`; sentences without an animation are skipped (returned as `missing`); stitching runs in the background, check `film.status` with `get`. |
| `qa` | `read` |  | Acceptance check: `legs[]` of `empty_start`, `end_match`, `carry`, `rhythm`, `rest` and `silent`, each `pass\|warn\|fail` with the offending sentence numbers in `items`, plus a `verdict`. |
| `delete` | `edit` | confirm | Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete this board (stills, animations and films already in the library are not deleted). |

## studio_paper

**Paper Explainer: topic to animated cut-paper reel.** Paper Explainer: a topic becomes a vertical explainer video of up to 30 seconds where the whole frame is a paper model: paper backgrounds, characters and props pop in piece by piece, with paper transitions, camera moves, handwritten marks, tape titles, word-by-word captions, voice, music and sound effects. An image model only draws the elements and animation is done by a motion template, so it is not a generated video. Use it when the user asks for paper craft, cut paper, paper collage, diorama or an explainer reel (use `studio_collage` for an existing narration as a one-take collage). Gates: approve script, draw elements (paid), voice track (free), approve storyboard (free stills), render (paid). Follow `next`; rendering requires an approved storyboard. Call `guide` first.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `guide` | `read` |  | One-page flow guide plus the catalog of all moves (transitions, cameras, effects, backdrops, props, sound effects, music). |
| `options` | `read` |  | All available moves: cuts, cameras, looks, entrances, moves, effects, backdrops, props, sfx, beds, layout. |
| `plan` | `edit` |  | Create a board. args `{topic (4-1500 chars), seconds? 12-30, language?, title?, voice?, mascot?, backdrops?, bed?, still_res?, notes?, refs?}`; returns `board_id`; script is AI-written in background. |
| `list` | `read` |  | List the user's paper explainers (id, topic, scene count, final `output_id`). |
| `get` | `read` |  | Get everything about a board: `stage`, `plan` (script, scenes, elements), `art`, `voice`, `board`, `render`, plus the next step. |
| `revise` | `edit` |  | Have AI rewrite from a note. args `{note}`; it must be re-approved afterwards. |
| `edit` | `edit` |  | Edit directly without AI (free). args `{scenes?:[{n, say?, banner?, bg?, cut?, cam?, look?, els?, fx?, sfx?}], parts?:[{key, desc}], hook?, bed?}`; names must come from `options`. |
| `approve` | `edit` |  | Approve. args `{what: plan\|board, ok?: false (withdraw)}`; call only after the user approves in person. |
| `quote` | `read` |  | Quote without charging. args `{what: art\|render, keys?}`. |
| `render_art` | `spend` | paid | Paid: draw the elements (up to 6 per sheet; without `keys` all missing ones). args `{keys?, seed?}`; returns job ids, then `collect`. |
| `collect` | `edit` |  | Collect results: finished elements are cut out automatically (`collected`/`pending`/`failed`); redraw missing ones with `render_art {keys}` (failed orders are refunded). |
| `adopt` | `edit` |  | Use an existing library image as an element. args `{key, output_id}`. |
| `voice` | `edit` |  | Free: synthesize narration, time the scenes to the real speech length, and produce music and sound effects. args `{voice?}` (30-90 s in the background). |
| `storyboard` | `edit` |  | Free: one still per scene (goes into the Storyboard folder); these props are the film's props. |
| `view` | `read` | image | View the contact sheet (returns an image). args `{what?: board\|parts}`; always show it to the user before approving the storyboard. |
| `render` | `spend` | paid | Paid: render the video, billed per second (a confirmation is returned above the threshold); returns `job_id`, then `get` until `stage:'done'`. |
| `delete` | `edit` | confirm | Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete this board (elements and voice track are deleted; finished films in the library are not). |
